body: PR #2794, head 1aa7ebcbda (branch claude/bug-2201, merged with origin/main 4e899764a9). Root cause: contained launches use --setting-sources project (drops user allows) and the template's permissions.allow is not a managed-merge slot, so aida-relay had no Bash(aida *). The child also had no AIDA_AGENT_TYPE, forcing the env-prefixed retry that got denied. Fix: baseline Bash(aida/git) + Read(worktree, main store/cache) in contained --settings (no write tools; fail-closed stays empty); AIDA_AGENT_TYPE on headless seat children; TASK-2040: contained review record writes the handshake into the worktree when the anchor is unwritable (launcher collects it, BUG-2149); the exit-30 error names the denied calls. Did NOT widen the write boundary to primary .aida/review-verdicts, which needs a ruling. Please confirm the Read/Bash baseline is acceptable for containment. Gates: check-ci-fast PASS; test-touched 874/874 pre-merge, 873/874 post-merge (bug_1983 grant test flake, passes in isolation x2); new e2e 2/2.
